title: Duality of Literal Pairs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and assign a Boolean value to each of its $n$ variables. For each variable, form the pair consisting of its positive literal and its negated literal. In every such pair, the value of the second circuit is the Boolean complement of the value of the first.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables
